description: This file contains the implementation of a JSON parser utility class, 'JsonValueParser', which provides methods to parse JSON data from strings and readers into JsonValue objects, utilizing the 'com.eclipsesource.json.JsonParser' library. It includes handling for exceptions and is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.json' package.

classes.name: JsonValueParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing JSON strings and readers into JsonValue objects. It handles JSON parsing exceptions and offers flexible parsing functions.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Returns a Consumer that parses a JSON string using the provided DittoJsonHandler and updates the handler with the parsed value.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Returns a Function that parses a JSON string into a JsonValue instance using default handling.

methods.name: fromReader
methods.description: Provides a Function to parse JSON data from a Reader into a JsonValue object.
